checks.name: Paywall present
checks.detail: Unpaid request drew HTTP 402 with a parseable x402 challenge.

checks.name: Challenge sanity
checks.detail: Challenge terms are complete and consistent: exact on eip155:8453, amount 20000 units ($0.02), payTo 0x097f9685D1e0752bF8B02d61E5Ce9be7eA0FBA7F.

checks.name: Garbage payment rejected
checks.detail: Base64-junk payment headers were rejected with a fresh 402 challenge.

checks.name: Exposure surface
checks.detail: None of /.env, /.git/config, /debug, /metrics, /admin answered with sensitive content.

checks.name: Error hygiene
checks.detail: Malformed-JSON and wrong-content-type requests drew clean errors (or a paywall 402) with no stack traces, paths, SQL, or debug pages.

checks.name: Body-cap sanity
checks.detail: Oversized (~1.1 MiB) body was refused with HTTP 413.

checks.name: Discovery consistency
checks.detail: Published discovery advertises the audited route with terms matching the live challenge.

scope_note: Automated security checks, not a penetration test. All probes are unpaid and non-destructive; checks that could not run are reported as not_tested, never as passes.
